instructions: Use dark background (#0A0A0A) with neon accent colors
Apply neon glow effects (box-shadow) to all interactive elements
Add musical notes floating animation in background
Use gradient overlays for buttons and important elements
Text should have subtle neon glow on headings
Cyberpunk grid pattern as background texture
